severityAudit.title: Sandwich Attack on Auto-Compound

analysis.assetRisk: Value leak from suboptimal compounding - LP value diluted but not directly stolen
analysis.attackPath: Valid but requires MEV infrastructure, mempool monitoring, and sufficient capital
analysis.impact: ~3.5% value extraction per compound operation demonstrated in PoC

severityAudit.reasoning: Value leak with documented external requirements (MEV infrastructure). Not direct asset theft - compounding still occurs, just at suboptimal ratios. Meets Medium criteria: 'value leak with stated assumptions and external requirements'.
severityAudit.notes: Well-documented finding with working PoC. Severity assessment is accurate.

severityAudit.title: ExactOut Swaps Bypass Hook Fees

analysis.assetRisk: Complete bypass of 0.05% hook fee - 100% revenue loss on exactOut swaps
analysis.attackPath: Trivial - simply use exactOut swaps instead of exactIn. No special tools or knowledge required.
analysis.impact: 100% fee bypass. For $1M daily volume (50% exactOut): $91,250/year lost

severityAudit.disagreementReason: Finding may be UNDERSTATED. Zero external conditions required + 100% fee bypass + guaranteed loss on every exactOut swap. The lack of ANY required conditions typically indicates High severity. However, since it affects protocol fees (not user funds), Medium is defensible.

argumentsForHigh: No external conditions required - any user can exploit
100% fee bypass, not partial mitigation failure
Guaranteed loss on every exactOut swap
argumentsForMedium: Affects protocol fees, not user principal
Individual loss per swap is small (0.05%)
Protocol can update contract to fix

severityAudit.notes: Borderline finding. Could reasonably be argued as High due to zero required conditions. Recommend emphasizing unconditional nature if keeping as Medium.

severityAudit.title: Single-Token Threshold Prevents Compounding

analysis.assetRisk: Opportunity cost - accumulated fees not compounded. Funds preserved but not utilized.
analysis.attackPath: Not an attack - design flaw triggered by natural market conditions
conditions: Threshold configured on token with less fee accumulation
analysis.impact: Core auto-compound functionality fails. PoC shows 50,000 tokens stuck due to 900 token shortfall.

severityAudit.reasoning: Protocol function/availability impacted - core auto-compound feature fails under realistic conditions. Funds are not at risk (preserved but idle). Owner can mitigate by adjusting threshold token. Clear Medium per C4 criteria.
severityAudit.notes: Design flaw rather than attack vector. Well-documented with clear PoC showing extreme imbalance scenarios.

recommendations.rationale: Severity is appropriate per C4 criteria

recommendations.action: Consider arguing for High OR emphasize unconditional nature
recommendations.rationale: Zero conditions + 100% bypass may warrant High; if keeping Medium, highlight these factors
Severity is appropriate per C4 criteria
